threat_summary: Super Cyclonic Storm AMPHAN is tracking north-northeast at 240 km/h sustained winds. Landfall expected along West Bengal coast near Sundarbans within 18–24 hours.

actionable_directives.fishermen: All fishing boats must return to shore immediately. Do not venture into the Bay of Bengal until further notice from INCOIS.
actionable_directives.general_public: Evacuate low-lying coastal areas within 5 km of shore. Secure loose objects. Stock emergency supplies for 72 hours.
actionable_directives.district_administration: Activate NDRF teams. Open all designated cyclone shelters. Pre-position emergency medical supplies at district hospitals.
